name: legal
description: Bounded EU (CELLAR), German federal court and Berlin legal research: exact works, separate language expressions, source-supported versions, cited passages with exact locators, explicit citations and as-of selection that never infers current force.

query_examples.semantics: exact identifier match across CELEX, ELI, ECLI, doknr, docket and official IDs

query_examples.intent: Which version of a Berlin law applied on 1 January 2020
query_examples.semantics: candidates with sourced commencement/validity evidence; missing or conflicting dates stay unknown or ambiguous
exact source passages with XML-path or paragraph locators; no relevance ranking
passage-level source changes, not a legal-effect assessment

query_examples.intent: What did each sanctions list state about a vessel on 1 March 2026
query_examples.semantics: per-list statements with listing revisions, aliases, programme, legal-basis passages and delistings; lists are never merged and there is no screening result

query_examples.intent: Which dual-use annex edition stated control code 1C350 on a date
query_examples.semantics: the consolidated edition applying on the date and the code's passage, with every acquired edition side by side

query_examples.intent: Which dockets and decisions cite 42 U.S.C. § 1983, as of 1 August 2099
query_examples.semantics: docket revisions current at the date with citing entries and decisions with quoted dispositions, linked by exact citation only

query_examples.intent: What had Exampland done under UNTC treaty XXVII-99 by 1 January 2095
query_examples.semantics: the participant's actions selected by the dates as published, with reservations, objections and notes verbatim and the depositary revision cited; pending and unclear stay explicit; no legal advice or obligation inference

query_examples.intent: Official robbery statistics for Germany with definitions and vintages
query_examples.semantics: each source's series with definition, unit, flags, coverage notes and vintage; no ranking or safety rating

query_examples.intent: Enforcement actions against a company and its group as of 1 June 2025
query_examples.semantics: SEC, FCA, EPA and EDPB actions reached through accepted identity matches, with outcomes, settlement wording, penalties and appeals as published and cited revisions; no score, no inferred wrongdoing

query_examples.intent: GDPR Article 32 decisions over 2025 with fines as published
query_examples.semantics: actions citing the basis exactly, penalties listed per authority and currency and never summed; undisclosed amounts explicit

exclusions: complete EU, German or Berlin law
all German case law
legal advice
inferred current force
relevance-ranked legal retrieval without accepted human-judged evaluation
other jurisdictions
undocumented provider APIs
screening verdicts
sanctions or AML compliance determinations
inferring that a similar name is the same party
merged cross-list party records
scraped sanctions portals (EU Sanctions Map)
personal profiles of private individuals in dockets
recidivism or risk scoring
neighbourhood safety ratings
rankings of places or countries
derived case outcome labels or predictions
unqualified cross-jurisdiction comparison of crime statistics
inference of treaty obligations or compliance
interpretation of the legal effect of reservations
treaty-text redistribution beyond what each source licenses
risk or compliance scoring of companies
inferring wrongdoing from an initiated enforcement action
treating settled 'neither admit nor deny' outcomes as findings
profiles of individuals named in enforcement actions
sums of penalties across currencies or authorities
